name: Straight cleaning through a corridor with side walls
expected: Ticks 1-4: left and right are both sampled true each tick while the front is clear. The RVC keeps moving forward with clean_on; the state stays FwdNormal and nothing is written (C13, C12).
The RVC leaves the corridor at (4,0) after tick 4.
Tick 5: wall ahead at (4,0), left (3,0) free: Turn Left + clean_off (R3, C4).
Tick 8: Forward + clean_on heading W. From tick 9 the left side (S) is the corridor wall again; it causes no reaction (C13).
function_text: EF-02 – Straight forward movement with normal cleaning (clean_on)
EF-04 – Periodic left/right/dust sampling, once per tick
EF-05 – Side-only obstacle with front clear causes no reaction
EF-06 – Avoidance: turn left, left has priority when both sides are free
EF-17 – Direction and Clean are sent only when their value changes; signals only on transitions
